test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: To complete a task, A and B take 24 days, B and C take 12 days and A, B and C take 6 days. A and C will take:
solution:
**Given:**

A and B: 24 days

B and C: 12 days

A, B, and C: 6 days

**Formula Used: **

1/A + 1/B + 1/C = 1/Together Time

**Calculation:**

Total work (LCM of 24, 12, 6) = 24 units

A and B together ⇒ Rate = 24 units / 24 days = 1 unit/day

B and C together ⇒ Rate = 24 units / 12 days = 2 units/day

A, B, and C together ⇒ Rate = 24 units / 6 days = 4 units/day

Rate of A = Rate of A, B, and C - Rate of B and c

⇒ Rate of A = 4 - 2 = 2 units/day

Similarly Rate of C = 4 - 1 = 3 units/day

Time taken by A and C alone = Total work / Rate of A and C ⇒ 24 units /( 3 + 2) units/day = 24/5 days

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
